steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Alright, alright, stop banging on the door. This is the FAC's super armored car, not the safe you're used to smashing.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: And stop throwing a tantrum, didn't you also use dirty tricks to kidnap my people?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Do whatever you want with me, just let the Commander go!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: This operation in the West is very important. If we can block BR-002, the West can be saved. So many innocent people won't have to be abandoned by the city-state! Now is not the time for you to throw a tantrum!!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Sure, sure, you know I don't care.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Give me a contact, I want to call your favorite <color=#fb9259>Hush</color> sister.
A familiar ringtone sounds from the other end of the walkie-talkie.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Oh, how convenient. She's calling you.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You took my phone?!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Shush, adults are talking, children shouldn't interrupt. I'll mute you.
Coquelic ignores Chris' roar, she directly answers the incoming call on the phone and turns on the speaker.

Behind the driver's cabin, the young girl is clearly irritated. She bangs on the door with all her might, trying to get the caller's attention. Coquelic leisurely holds the phone between herself and the walkie-talkie. The car is going fast and noisy.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Hello, Mentor.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hello, Hush. I have your people, but you don't seem surprised at all.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: After the first time you kidnapped her, Christina was implanted with a locator. I knew she was near the Rust. Naturally, she was kidnapped by you again.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: That's strange, I've had her kidnapped for several hours. Why are you only calling now?
Coquelic notices the banging on the door stops abruptly, she lets out a cold laugh and continues to focus on the phone call.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Taking a living person as my tracker, how shameless. The little girl must be heartbroken.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The Commander-in-Chief is there too, isn't he? We've already locked onto the vehicle's location. This time, it's not the sheriff or the FAC chasing you, it's the Paradeisos exclusive HUSH unit.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: We can still talk now, Mentor.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ha, your HUSH unit has been harassing me since June, don't act so distant.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: And besides, I didn't pick up your call to take orders from you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Listen, Hush of Paradeisos. This car contains your Commander-in-Chief, a dozen important negotiators, and the Underground Mania bomb you hate the most. It's heading towards Eastside.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Right now, an Underground Puppet is driving the car, sniping won't affect it. If anything causes the car to slow down during the journey, the bomb will immediately detonate, and the M-value within a kilometer radius will exceed 2000.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The only way to defuse the bomb is to dismantle the detonator directly, it's on the old man. The old man is next to your puppy.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: As for whether she has the ability to do this... heh, we both know the answer.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It's 11:32 in the morning now, in less than half an hour, this car will reach the first densely populated area of Eastside. I'm not like you, I don't negotiate.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: This is what you asked for.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Understood. This is indeed a choice you would make.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The operation in the West District is necessary, so is the Commander-in-Chief. The demands of Paradeisos are clear, and I will eliminate the threat at the lowest cost.
The car is bumped a few times, something has clung to the roof. Quite a few... it's the HUSH elite squad.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...Hmph, don't be so sure.
Coquelic hangs up the phone and casually unmutes the walkie-talkie. The other end is silent.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Alright, kiddo, don't sulk. So you're being overlooked, that's nothing new.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Your dearest Shalom sent the Hush squad, but they're not here to save you. Of course, they can't stop me either.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I've told you how to play. Your detective game isn't over yet, want to continue?
After a moment of silence, a low but firm voice comes from the other end of the walkie-talkie.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I will win. I won't let you have your way.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hahahaha!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Good, then show me your justice.
The Underground Mania Puppet is driving the car, Coquelic reaches into its body, pulls out a jet-black sturdy floral sword. She breaks the car window, and vaults onto the roof of the car.
Facing the rushing wind, she raises her hand to impale three white-masked men who leap onto the roof, throwing them off the car. They tumble and bounce like trash, destroying several chasing cars.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Let's see how ridiculous it is.
